cluster_name.description: Optional cluster name filter; use an empty string to query all clusters.

index_name.description: Optional index name filter; use an empty string to query all indices.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours).

configuration.query:
FROM .monitoring-es-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE metricset.name == "index"
| WHERE elasticsearch.cluster.name IS NOT NULL AND elasticsearch.index.name IS NOT NULL
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR elasticsearch.cluster.name == ?cluster_name)
| WHERE (?index_name == "" OR elasticsearch.index.name == ?index_name)
| STATS indexing_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.indexing.index_total), indexing_time_ms = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.indexing.index_time_in_millis), docs_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.docs.count), segments_count = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.segments.count), store_size_bytes = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.store.size_in_bytes), shards_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.shards.total), search_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.search.query_total), search_time_ms = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.search.query_time_in_millis), request_cache_evictions = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.request_cache.evictions), bulk_total_ops = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.bulk.total_operations), bulk_total_time_ms = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.bulk.total_time_in_millis) BY elasticsearch.cluster.name, elasticsearch.index.name
| EVAL avg_index_latency_ms = CASE(indexing_total > 0, indexing_time_ms / indexing_total, 0), pressure_score = indexing_total + search_total + COALESCE(shards_total, 0) * 100 + COALESCE(segments_count, 0) * 100 + COALESCE(store_size_bytes, 0) / 100000000
| SORT pressure_score DESC
| LIMIT 25

description: Find heavy indexing volume, latency, or storage pressure by index.
